changes.evidence: The kidnapping happens in S1#10 (The Bridge): Raina and Centipede soldiers take Coulson on the bridge and, flying away, she tells him they want to know how he returned from the dead. The memory machine and Skye's rescue are S1#11 (The Magical Place). The stage starts at #11 but its first event is #10.

changes.evidence: In S1#14 (T.A.H.I.T.I.) Garrett appears as an ally: he questions Quinn and joins the Guest House raid for the drug that saves Skye; no one knows he is the Clairvoyant. He is exposed as the Clairvoyant in S1#17 (Turn, Turn, Turn), and Skye freeing Ace turns Deathlok on him in S1#22 (Beginning of the End). The #14 stage names him the Clairvoyant three episodes early and tells #22 events.

changes.evidence: In S1#22 (Beginning of the End) Raina finds Zabo, who believed he would never see her again, and shows him Skye's photo. That he found her as a girl on the streets is first told in S2#5 (A Hen in the Wolf House: 'what you were when I found you: hungry, in the streets with just the fairy tales your grandmother told you') and again in S2#9.

owner_calls.question: Stage 1 (S1#22) only tells Mike turning on Garrett, not anything between Trip and Mike. Keep it as the point where Mike stops being Trip's enemy, or drop it?
options: keep, but change kind from enemy to ally
owner_calls.evidence: In S1#22 (Beginning of the End) Deathlok turns on Garrett once Skye frees Ace; Trip fights the Centipede soldiers and breaks a wall with Coulson using a Humvee. No source shows a direct Trip and Mike moment in the episode.
